        expires = datetime.strptime(not_after, "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
    except ValueError as exc:
        print(f"FAIL: bad expiration date {not_after!r}: {exc}")
        sys.exit(1)

    if expires < datetime.now(timezone.utc):
        print(f"FAIL: certificate expired on {expires:%Y-%m-%d}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Certificate file: {CERT_FILE}")
    print(f"Subject: {', '.join(f'{k} = {v}' for k, v in subject)}")
    print(f"Common Name: {cn}")
    print(f"Expiration date: {expires:%Y-%m-%d}")
    print("Certificate verification successful")
